supersession_reason: Pre-outcome implementation audit against experiments/training_ladder/exposure_executor.py found V2 described 4-bit NF4 and LoRA dropout 0.05, whereas the corrected Phase-1 executor used AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained without a quantization override and LoraConfig(r=8, alpha=16, dropout=0.0, bias=none, task_type=CAUSAL_LM). No Phase-2 model output had been accessed. V3 binds the actual Phase-1-equivalent training semantics and is the only outcome-authorizing protocol.

training.loading_semantics: AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained on the exact pinned revision/snapshot with no post-freeze quantization or dtype policy change. If the exact model cannot fit the available accelerator, emit RESOURCE_BLOCKED.
training.tokenizer_semantics: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained exact pinned revision; pad token set to eos only if absent
training.target_modules_note: Explicit q_proj/v_proj binding is the version-stable Qwen2 specialization of the Phase-1 PEFT CAUSAL_LM default; changing it requires a new protocol before outcomes.
training.loss: causal-LM gold-token loss with prompt tokens masked exactly as exposure_executor.py v2
training.determinism: python/numpy/torch seeds fixed; deterministic algorithms warn_only=True as in Phase-1 executor
training.final_checkpoint_rule: Each arm final checkpoint is trained from the same frozen base on exactly its final 48 selected examples for 12 epochs. C/E intermediate selection checkpoints are independently retrained from the same base on their cumulative selected examples; intermediate checkpoints do not enter confirmatory outcome statistics except through the preregistered selection rule.

arms.A_UNIFORM_RANDOM: 48 examples sampled without replacement from the union of equal-size exposure pools with seed 46601; selection does not inspect exposure label, gold, verifier or model state.
arms.B_SEMANTIC_DIVERSITY: Greedy farthest-first prompt selection by token-set Jaccard distance only, deterministic case-id tie break; no gold, verifier, model loss or mastery state.
arms.C_STRONGEST_MODEL_AWARE_PARENT: Round 1 uses a pre-frozen balanced seed batch. At rounds 2-6, retrain a cumulative selection checkpoint and evaluate the shared selection probes; choose the next exposure group with the largest mean binary-label negative log likelihood, deterministic tie break by exposure order. This parent sees learner loss but no RAKL mastery threshold, protected safety vector or novelty semantics.
arms.D_STATIC_RAKL_STRUCTURAL: Exactly 8 examples from each exposure type, selected by pre-frozen seed; no learner state changes allocation.
arms.E_ADAPTIVE_RAKL_STRUCTURAL: Round 1 uses the same balanced seed batch as C. At rounds 2-6, retrain/evaluate a cumulative selection checkpoint, form the six-coordinate accuracy vector, reserve one SAME_STRUCTURE slot per batch, prioritize PRINCIPLE until >=0.90, prioritize RETENTION if <0.80, otherwise target the lowest measured non-principle coordinate. A coordinate is blocked if the previous-round drop in SAME_STRUCTURE or HOSTILE_NEAR_MISS exceeds 0.10 after selecting it; deterministic coordinate and case-id ties. No scalar utility may compensate a blocked safety coordinate.

primary_estimand: E-D fresh balanced accuracy across the six equal fresh-assurance strata

statistics.multiplicity: Holm over E-D, E-C and D-B
statistics.success: E-D point >=0.05 and paired CI lower>0; Holm-adjusted E-D significant; E-C CI lower>=-0.02; every hard-harm E-D CI lower>-0.05; full selection/training/probe resource accounting reported.
statistics.missing_invalid: count incorrect; retain in safety and cost accounting

resource_envelope.accelerator: A100-class or other accelerator able to run the exact pinned unmodified loading/training semantics
resource_envelope.forbidden_repair_after_outcomes: smaller model, changed quantization, reduced epochs, changed MDE, changed panel or changed parent

decision_tree.PARENT_MATCHES_OR_BEATS: E-C violates -0.02 noninferiority or C is distinguishably better
decision_tree.STATIC_EQUALS_ADAPTIVE: E-D precision excludes +0.05 while including 0 and no hard harm
decision_tree.RESOURCE_BLOCKED: exact 7B Phase-2 cannot execute under the frozen resource envelope
decision_tree.INVALID_CONTAMINATED: data overlap, label leakage, cross-arm state, or post-outcome protocol/evaluator mutation

authority_boundary: Training allocation only. No theorem/scientific authority. Paper IV standalone authorization remains issue #462 and depends on the terminal produced by this exact frozen protocol.
